overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains an active cross-platform academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content focuses heavily on computational social science, disinformation research, software releases (CooRnet), grant announcements, and academic hiring. LinkedIn drives the highest total interaction counts (likes and comments), while Bluesky shows strong viral amplification (high repost-to-like ratios).

contentThemes.description: Sharing new research papers, software tools like CooRnet v2.0, and grant wins related to coordinated inauthentic behavior and disinformation.
Promoting postdoctoral positions and PhD opportunities within computational social science.
Discussing platform methodologies and upcoming speaking engagements like #DisinfoConf2025.

recommendations: Cross-post high-performing professional milestones (like grant wins) across Bluesky and Mastodon to capitalize on audience interest in research updates.
Increase engagement on LinkedIn by encouraging discussions around newly released tools and methodological papers, not just hiring and funding announcements.
Leverage Bluesky's high repost rate by including call-to-action links and visuals to drive traffic to published research papers.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates high audience resonance with research releases and PhD opportunities, yielding strong repost ratios relative to follower count.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a focused academic niche with steady engagement around open-source tools (CooRnet) and methodological discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Commands the largest single audience (1,850 followers) and generates the highest raw engagement (likes and comments) for career milestones and grant announcements.
